This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the game [[Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR!]] for the [[Game Boy Color]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Hudson Soft]].
